subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Should this refactor remove the documented ACP `streamLogPath` contract and land the plugin/schema migrations in one upgrade, or must it preserve a compatible diagnostics access path and complete all producer and consumer migrations first?
rationale: The branch changes a documented accepted-response field, public plugin doctor context, and persisted schemas; repository policy requires explicit owner judgment and upgrade proof before accepting those compatibility choices.

options.title: Preserve compatibility first
options.body: Keep or replace the ACP history handle, update all writers, readers, docs, and guard exemptions, then require fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Accept a breaking cutover
options.body: Remove the old handle and paths in one release only with explicit owner approval and proof that the resulting downstream and upgrade impact is intentional.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility first
recommendation.body: Keep or replace the ACP history handle, update all writers, readers, docs, and guard exemptions, then require fresh-install and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent merged SQLite storage work makes this the strongest available owner for the migration and per-agent schema choice.
